Name: Living Portrait
Author: Batimaax
Description:
[size=6]Living Portrait[/size]

Give your farmer a [b]personal portrait in the dialogue box[/b], to the left of whoever you're talking to, that changes with your world: the [b]season, weather, time of day, festivals, where you are, whether you're indoors or still in your pyjamas, and your mood[/b]. On top of that you can switch on a [b]dynamic background[/b] that shifts with the weather and time, a small context-aware [b]decorative ornament[/b], and a personal [b]name banner[/b]. Everything is optional and configurable in-game.

Under the hood it's a Content Patcher pack (just JSON and art, no code of its own). It hands custom art to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits[/url] mod, which does the actual drawing. This download also bundles [b]Frame Fit[/b], a small C# companion that scales the dialogue portraits to fill the wooden frame and remove the empty gap below them.

[size=4]Heads up: beta[/size]
The farmer busts are hand-drawn and finished across the whole set, and the decorative ornaments are final art too. What's still temporary in this build are the [b]dynamic skies and name banners[/b], which are simple placeholder graphics for now while permission to bundle the upstream sky art is arranged. Everything works fully, so you can see every reaction and every mode in action today. It's a beta so the system can be tested in the wild, and feedback is very welcome.
This mod give you the tool to personalize every layer of the conversation frame. To personnalise your portrait, either the individual portraits you want in game (I draw each of them as place holders for you), or use the integrated farmer representation from the Farmer portrait mod by unchecking the "Use personalized farmer portrait option".

[size=4]Background modes[/size]
Pick one under [b]Background[/b] in the settings:
[list]
[*][b]Default[/b]: the game's normal wooden portrait frame.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic[/b]: a full sky that changes with the weather and time of day (the wooden frame is replaced by the sky).[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Framed[/b]: that same changing sky drawn inside the wooden frame, so the frame stays put.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Settings[/size]
Everything is optional, and if the art for a given situation isn't there, the portrait quietly falls back to the next best one. In GMCM you control the master switch, emotions, the weather tier, festivals, the three background modes and indoor overlay, the personal banner, and the context-aware ornaments. (Which ornaments can show in a context is set by which art files you keep in each context folder, not by toggles.) A lot of this ships switched on so you can see the whole system at once, so turn off anything you don't want.

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
Living Portrait takes over the farmer portrait and the wooden portrait-frame region, so if you run any of these, turn them off:
[list]
[*]Other packs that replace the farmer portrait (Farmer Portrait, Seasonal Farmer Portraits, Farmer Emotion, and so on).[/*]
[*]Standalone Portrait Frame Variations, Changing Skies, or Portraited Changing Skies. This mod already includes that art and edits the same region.[/*]
[*]Any "Farmer Portraits background" option in another pack. It stops Farmer Portraits from sampling the live region, which freezes the dynamic background.[/*]
[/list]One thing to know: because the dynamic background edits the shared portrait-frame texture, the NPC's (and the shopkeeper's) portrait background gets themed too. That's a known trade-off of this approach.

[size=4]Multiplayer[/size]
Each player runs Farmer Portraits plus this pack locally and sees their own farmer's portrait. The pack holds a single art set, so everyone installs their own copy.

[size=4]License[/size]
The code and the hand-drawn farmer busts are by Batimax under the MIT license. The bundled ornaments are from Portrait Frame Variations by ItsBenter (a free-to-use modder's resource), and the wooden frame and default name plate are based on Stardew Valley's own UI art by ConcernedApe. Because the bundled ornament art is only free while this mod stays free, please don't sell it or put it on paid platforms. The Frame Fit add-on is MIT-licensed original code with no third-party assets.

[size=5]Installation instructions[/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and one Farmer Portraits fork (mistyspring's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits 1.6[/url], recommended, or aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url]), plus [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for the settings screen.[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]Download Living Portrait and unzip it into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder. You'll get a [i]Living Portrait[/i] folder with the content pack and the optional [i]Frame Fit[/i] add-on. SMAPI loads both. (Delete the Frame Fit folder if you don't want it.)[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI once to generate the config.[/*]
[*]Open [b]Farmer Portraits' own settings[/b] and check two things: keep [b]Use Custom Portrait[/b] on (or the art is ignored), and turn [b]Portrait Reactions[/b] on if you want the emotion busts. Portrait Reactions is off by default in Farmer Portraits, so the emotions do nothing until you enable it there.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Main features[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Reactive portrait[/b]: your farmer's bust changes with the season, weather, time of day, festivals, location, indoor/pyjama state, and emotion, using a graceful most-specific-wins fallback.[/*]
[*][b]Three background modes[/b]: [b]Default[/b] (vanilla wooden frame), [b]Dynamic[/b] (full weather/time sky), and [b]Dynamic Framed[/b] (a changing sky inside the wooden frame).[/*]
[*][b]Context-aware ornaments[/b]: finished decorative overlays that follow the season, location, crops, and festivals.[/*]
[*][b]Personal name banner[/b]: an optional name plate that adapts to context.[/*]
[*][b]Fully configurable in GMCM[/b]: master switch, emotions, weather tier, festivals, background modes, indoor overlay, banner, and ornaments. Every feature is optional and degrades gracefully.[/*]
[*][b]Frame Fit companion[/b]: scales the NPC and farmer dialogue portraits to fill the wooden frame, with independent scale and offset for each, tunable in GMCM.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]

[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+ (Stardew Valley 1.6+), required[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] 2.0+, required[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Farmer Portraits, required (it renders the portrait): either mistyspring's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits 1.6[/url] (recommended) or aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url]. Install one.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], recommended (the in-game settings screen)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url], optional (only for the special-event ornaments)[/size][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Living Portrait
Manifest.Description: Personalised farmer portrait in the dialogue box (works with either Farmer Portraits fork: mistyspring's or aedenthorn's), reacting to season, weather, time, festival, location, indoor/pajama state and emotion, with an optional dynamic weather/time background, decorative ornament and name banner. Bundles the Frame Fit companion that scales the dialogue portraits to fill the wooden frame. Fully GMCM-configurable, all optional with graceful fallback. Install one Farmer Portraits fork. Beta: ships placeholder dynamic-sky and name-banner art while permission to bundle the upstream sky art is arranged.
Manifest.Author: Batimax

Manifest.Name: Living Portrait Frame Fit
Manifest.Description: Scales the dialogue portraits to fill the wooden frame, removing the gap below them. The NPC portrait works standalone (no other mod needed); the farmer portrait needs a Farmer Portraits fork (mistyspring's or aedenthorn's, auto-detected) with 'Use Custom Portrait' on. Built for Living Portrait's Dynamic Framed mode but works with or without it. GMCM-tunable.
Manifest.Author: Batimax
